      "original_title": "The microRNA miR-34a inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and metastasis by directly repressing CD44",
      "original_authors": "Liu, C; Kelnar, K; Liu, B; Chen, X; Calhoun-Davis, T; Li, H; Patrawala, L; Yan, H; Jeter, C; Honorio, S; Wiggins, J; Bader, A; Fagin, R; Brown, D; Tang, D",
      "original_year": "2011",
      "original_journal": "Nature Medicine",
      "description": "miR-34a is underexpressed in CD44+ LAPC4 cells relative to CD44- LAPC4 cells",
      "citation_sentence": "This experiment is comparable to what was reported in Figure 1B of Liu et al. (2011) and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015).",
      "gt_ambiguity": "clear",
      "notes": "The replication found miR-34a was elevated at 202% in CD44+ cells (opposite direction from the original's 3.4%). The gating strategy was changed from top 10% to top 1% due to weak CD44 signal. Let-7b was in the same direction as the original, but miR-34a was not."

      "original_title": "The microRNA miR-34a inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and metastasis by directly repressing CD44",
      "original_authors": "Liu, C; Kelnar, K; Liu, B; Chen, X; Calhoun-Davis, T; Li, H; Patrawala, L; Yan, H; Jeter, C; Honorio, S; Wiggins, J; Bader, A; Fagin, R; Brown, D; Tang, D",
      "original_year": "2011",
      "original_journal": "Nature Medicine",
      "description": "Expression of miR-34a inhibits tumor regeneration of LAPC4 cells in NOD/SCID mice",
      "citation_sentence": "This experiment is similar to what was reported in Supplemental Figure 5C of Liu et al. (2011) and described in Protocol 4 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015).",
      "gt_ambiguity": "clear",
      "notes": "The original reported miR-34a inhibited tumor regeneration (0.15g vs 0.54g control at 69 days). The replication found similar tumor weights between miR-34a transduced and control groups (0.55g vs 0.51g at 100 days), not statistically significant (t(18)=0.432, p=0.671). The original used n=6; replication used n=7."
    },

      "result": "inconclusive",
      "replication_type": "close experiment",
      "original_url": "https://doi.org/10.1038/nm.2284",
      "original_title": "The microRNA miR-34a inhibits prostate cancer stem cells and metastasis by directly repressing CD44",
      "original_authors": "Liu, C; Kelnar, K; Liu, B; Chen, X; Calhoun-Davis, T; Li, H; Patrawala, L; Yan, H; Jeter, C; Honorio, S; Wiggins, J; Bader, A; Fagin, R; Brown, D; Tang, D",
      "original_year": "2011",
      "original_journal": "Nature Medicine",
      "description": "CD44 expression is inversely correlated with miR-34a expression in tumors from DU145 cells transduced with miR-34a",
      "citation_sentence": "This experiment was described in Protocol 5 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015) and is conceptually similar to what was reported in Figure 4A of Liu et al. (2011), which used DU145 cells transduced with a retroviral vector encoding miR-34a.",
      "gt_ambiguity": "ambiguous",
      "notes": "The replication used LAPC4 cells with lentiviral vectors instead of DU145 cells with retroviral vectors. Critically, miR-34a was not detectable in tumors from miR-34a transduced LAPC4 cells in vivo (likely silenced), so the CD44 result cannot be interpreted as a direct test of the original claim. The authors note this complicates interpretation."

      "original_year": "2011",
      "original_journal": "Nature Medicine",
      "description": "miR-34a directly represses CD44 through binding sites in the 3'UTR of CD44, as measured by luciferase reporter assay",
      "citation_sentence": "This is similar to what was reported in Figure 4D of Liu et al. (2011) and described in Protocol 7 in the Registered Report (Li et al., 2015).",
      "gt_ambiguity": "clear",
      "notes": "The original reported decreased luciferase signal with wild-type reporter + miR-34a oligos (0.67 vs 1.00), partially abrogated with double mutant (0.78 vs 1.00).
